name: slope-chart
title: Slope Chart
description: Each thing's value at two moments joined by a line, so what rose, what fell and how the ranking changed read at once: names and values at both ends, rises solid and falls dashed so direction never rests on colour.

meta.when: Comparing many things between exactly two moments or conditions: this year and last, before and after a change. For many moments use line-chart or small-multiples; for one thing's change use a stat with its delta; for a few categories use dot-plot dumbbell.
meta.example:
<SlopeChart
  label="Share of trips by mode"
  data={[
    { mode: "Car", y2016: 52, y2026: 41 },
    { mode: "Bike", y2016: 9, y2026: 18 },
    { mode: "Transit", y2016: 24, y2026: 27 },
  ]}
  name="mode"
  from="y2016"
  to="y2026"
  fromLabel="2016"
  toLabel="2026"
/>
